# horseriding

Enhances immersion by incorporating camera movement during horse riding

This mod is in its early stages of development and may contain bugs or conflict with other mods.
## Features
- Smooth motion-based sway
- Adds FOV correction when moving forward
- No additional dependencies
- Runs entirely on the client side

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Combine with Fix Horizontal Camera Lag and Fresh Animations for even greater immersion.
